name: Continued Studies
body:
You continue to improve the abilities of your original career even after undertaking a new path.

Prerequisite(s): Favored Prestige Class with selected prestige class.

Benefit(s): Choose one class feature (other than spellcasting) that improves with your class level, like barbarian rage or bardic performance. You add your level in your chosen prestige class to your level in the class that grants you the selected feature for that feature’s purpose. This doesn’t grant you any new abilities.

Special: You can select the Continued Studies feat more than once. Each time, it affects a different class feature. If your favored prestige class grants bonus feats, you may select this feat in place of a bonus feat.
